from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single paper document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles found in the paper's bibliography/references section")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction for the provided documents."""
    papers: list[Paper] = Field(description="List of all papers extracted from the input documents")
